summary: Renames the order detail view from order_detail to show_order. It also limits the loaded Order fields to number and total_cents.

findings.title: URLconf still references removed order_detail view
findings.problem: The change renames order_detail to show_order. The route at orders/urls.py:8 still calls views.order_detail.
findings.consequence: Django raises AttributeError when it imports orders/urls.py. Every URL that goes through the project URLconf then fails, not just the order detail page.
findings.fix: Update orders/urls.py:8 to use views.show_order, or keep the name order_detail.
